objectives: Spell taught ps-words such as psalm, psychic, and psychology.
Retain p in conventional spelling although it is silent in speech.
Distinguish pronunciation from the written form.
concepts: In the taught initial ps-words, p is silent.
Silent letters remain in conventional spelling.
The remaining letters represent the pronounced sounds.
Rereading checks sound-to-letter knowledge and conventional form.
